request: Fix Aura on mobile: stop Aura's desktop composer-centering CSS from applying below BB's 768px breakpoint so the native New thread composer stays pinned to the bottom of the viewport for thumb reach, with the recents list scrolling above it. Keep the existing centered composition at 768px and wider, keep the wallpaper and half-wallpaper behavior, and verify the real mobile UI at 390x844 with screenshots plus the existing checks.
message: Planned the CSS scope change, lifecycle assertion, real-browser mobile/desktop check, docs and version bump.
